_note: 产品对比数据（Compare 3）。参数值全部来自各产品规格页；Best for 来自 POSITIONING-20261107 的按约束选型，不是营销话术。

fora.name: Fora
fora.form: Central power cabinet + up to 16 dispensers
fora.connectors: CCS2 / GB/T · liquid-cooled up to 600 A
fora.best_for: Very high-throughput corridors and hubs where one site must serve many bays
fora.efficiency: Liquid-cooled 0–600 A terminals; OCPP 1.6J native, 2.0.1 compatible
fora.expansion: Add dispensers to the same cabinet (6/8/10/12/16 configurations)

vulco.name: Vulco
vulco.best_for: Sites expected to grow: start on the power you have and add modules when utilisation justifies it
vulco.climate: Reserved heater interface for sub-zero regions
vulco.expansion: 120 → 480 kW upgrade path without replacing the cabinet

pales.name: Pales
pales.connectors: 2 × DC: CCS2 (250 A) and GB/T (250 A)
pales.best_for: Mixed fleets that must accept both CCS2 and GB/T at one station
pales.expansion: Power configurable at order; no field module upgrade

castor.name: Castor
castor.best_for: Small sites, depots and destination parking where a full cabinet is oversized
castor.expansion: Add units per bay; no shared cabinet

aquila.name: Aquila
aquila.connectors: 2 × DC: CCS2 (200 A) and GB/T (250 A)
aquila.best_for: High-footfall commercial sites where advertising or tenant revenue closes part of the business case
aquila.efficiency: OCPP 1.6J · image ads standard, video on request

bess.name: BESS 120 / 261 / 418 kWh
bess.connectors: Pairs with any DC family on site
bess.best_for: Weak grid, peak shaving or off-grid: storage is sized before the charger is chosen
bess.expansion: AC-side parallel to GWh scale (418 kWh) · on/off-grid transfer <50 ms
